title: THE TWIST · ROTATION EMOM
why: GREEN (8 h, nothing sore, wants it hard) the day after a leg-heavy tower, so today is upper body + rotation on a strict minute clock with short flat sprints. Six sprint legs at 10.0 mph keep the run in without stacking more miles on the legs.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine / hips

blocks.title: THE TWIST · EMOM 24 · 6 CYCLES
blocks.meta: 6 CYCLES of 4 minutes · one station per minute · minute 4 is a sprint · 52 lb DB + 35 lb bell
blocks.format: Every minute on the minute, 24 minutes. Odd cycles (1, 3, 5) = Set A. Even cycles (2, 4, 6) = Set B. Do the reps, rest the remainder. Score = minutes where the reps finished inside the minute (green 24 / yellow 20).
blocks.workRest: MINUTE 4 of every cycle: SPRINT 30 s @ 10.0 mph flat, then step off and walk to the top of the next minute (6 sprints, ~0.5 mi).

items.name: SET A · min 1 · Floor press with glute bridge 52 lb · 8/side
items.detail: hips up and held, press one arm, switch at 8

items.name: SET A · min 2 · Dead rotational clean 52 lb · 6/side
items.detail: DB on the floor outside the foot, rotate through the hips, clean to the shoulder, set it back down dead each rep

items.name: SET A · min 3 · Pallof press-out 35 lb · 8/side, 2-ct hold
items.detail: half-kneeling, bell at the chest, press straight out, hold 2, do not let the torso turn

items.name: SET B · min 1 · Bench pullover 52 lb · 12
items.detail: ribs down, lower to the ears, pull back over the chest

items.name: SET B · min 2 · Kneeling single-arm high pull 35 lb · 10/side
items.detail: tall-kneeling, hike the bell back, pull it high with the elbow leading, swap at 10

items.name: SET B · min 3 · Bent press 35 lb · 3/side
items.detail: WILDCARD (14 d) · bell racked, fold sideways under it until the arm locks, stand up

items.name: EVERY CYCLE · min 4 · SPRINT 30 s @ 10.0 flat

blocks.noteGreen: Green = 24 of 24 minutes made. Log minutes made, first minute that ran over, RPE.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 5 cycles (20 min), floor press 6/side, pullover 10, sprint @ 9.5.

blocks.title: THE TWIST FINISH · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · chop + Copenhagen + bird dog · straight through

items.name: Half-kneeling chop 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: bell from the outside hip up and across to the far shoulder, arms long

items.name: Copenhagen hold, top foot on the bench · 20 s/side
items.detail: on the elbow, bottom leg bent and free, hips high, top inner thigh does the work

items.name: Bird dog, 3-ct hold ×6/side
items.detail: hand and knee on the floor, opposite arm and leg long, hips level
